_about: Snapshot of Nanawing (fpvsim) facts used by www pages. Source of truth is the fpvsim repo; M3 of docs/site-consolidation-plan.md replaces this hand-made snapshot with the product.json the fpvsim build publishes. Update it whenever these facts change in fpvsim.

source.release: TBS Chupito release: fpvsim main 7035add (15 Oct 2026); leaderboard worker e3948a05.

aircraft.name: WUDFLY Spectre
aircraft._name: Owner decision 2026-10-07: 'WUDFLY Spectre' wherever a name is shown (fpvsim catalog.ts still says 'Spectre').
aircraft.short: Light, agile. Made for close flying.

credit.text: Aircraft design by WUDFLY. The simulator model is an original recreation; handling is a simulator approximation, not a manufacturer-validated flight model.

aircraft.name: TBS Chupito

credit.text: Reference airframe by Team BlackSheep. Nanawing's own recreation; its handling is not TBS flight data.

aircraft._credit: Team BlackSheep's written permission (15 Oct 2026, ticket TBS-S261014-D3E0): name and recognisable product livery may be used if it is presented accurately, never as an official TBS simulator or an endorsement; every public surface that shows it credits Team BlackSheep and links url above. No TBS photographs.

aircraft.name: Darkwing
aircraft._spanM: Assumed from the STL files (no units; millimetres assumed). Unconfirmed by the designer.
aircraft.short: Builds speed in a hurry on 6S.

credit.text: Aircraft by Anirudh. Nanawing's own recreation, tuned from flights of the real aircraft.

aircraft._credit: Published with Anirudh's agreement (owner, 20 Oct 2026); credit 'Aircraft by Anirudh', linked to the profile he chose. The original STL files are not redistributed.

_courses: aircraft = the course's allow-list (fpvsim RaceCourseDef.aircraft; courseAllowsAircraft in src/race/courses.ts); absent = every aircraft. Estate Run (Parkland, beta) comes from src/world/parkland/parklandCourses.json (14 gates + the START arch, lapKm 2.8), released to fpvsim main with Parkland on 2026-10-14 for the Spectre; the TBS Chupito release (15 Oct 2026) opens it to the Chupito too. The production leaderboard worker must accept chupito on every course, Estate Run included, before this snapshot ships: src/aircraft-records.js reads those boards, and a failed board marks the page degraded.
